name: Acid Arrow
material: Powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach
description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit the target takes 4d4 acid damage now and 2d4 more at the end of its next turn. On a miss it takes half the initial damage and nothing later.
at_higher_levels: Both damage amounts rise by 1d4 per slot level above 2.
